en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing an ornate stone well or fountain in front of a stucco building with two large windows. The well has a richly decorated wrought‑iron canopy supported by slender columns, topped by a small statue of a figure holding a flag. The light and shadows emphasize the baroque ornamentation. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.
